cards.name: Magic Drain
cards.officialBehavior: When your opponent activates a Spell Card: They can discard 1 Spell to negate this card's effect, otherwise negate the activation of their Spell Card, and if you do, destroy it.
adapterBehavior: Only opens for an opponent Spell activation in the current response window.
At resolution, the active physical representative who activated the Spell may optionally discard a Spell from their own private hand to negate Magic Drain's effect.
If no Spell is discarded, the target Spell activation is negated and the activated card is moved to its physical owner's team Graveyard.
A discarded Spell is moved to its physical owner's team Graveyard; the inactive partner's hand is never searched or consumed.

cards.name: Cursed Seal of the Forbidden Spell
cards.officialBehavior: When a Spell Card is activated: Discard 1 Spell; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it, and if you do that, your opponent cannot activate Spell Cards with that name for the rest of this Duel.
adapterBehavior: Requires a Spell discard as an activation cost from the active physical representative's private hand, even when the Set Trap belongs to the inactive partner.
Negates the current Spell activation and attempts to destroy that exact physical card.
Adds a duel-session name lock for the opposing team only after both activation negation and destruction succeed.
The name lock is serialized in the adapter session and checked through canTeamActivateSpell.

tests: Magic Drain response eligibility and Set-turn restrictions
Magic Drain optional opponent discard from the active physical hand
Magic Drain negation/destruction when the opponent declines to discard
invalid partner/non-Spell discard rejection without input mutation
Cursed Seal activation cost from the active representative, not the Set partner
Cursed Seal cost availability and physical-hand ownership
Cursed Seal cost is not refunded when its activation is negated
Cursed Seal chain-link negation and persistent name lock
Cursed Seal name lock requires successful destruction

invariants.privateHands: not enumerated or leaked by adapter actions

limitations: The adapter is isolated and is not wired into the authoritative resolver, tagActions, tagInteraction, Discord commands, or catalog v9.
The duel-long Cursed Seal name lock is persisted in the adapter session only; central duel persistence must be integrated after the M61 handoff.
Tests use the local TagDuel state machine and fixtures; no live Discord gateway or guild was contacted.
No card certification or inventory availability is claimed.
